# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first

    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 45.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

def peak_after(node: NodeState, pod: Pod) -> float:
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu_after, mem_after)

def fits_with_margin(node: NodeState, pod: Pod, limit: float) -> bool:
    if node.suspended:
        return False
    peak = peak_after(node, pod)
    return peak <= limit

def move_benefit(state: ClusterState, pod: Pod, to_node: int, rate: float) -> float:
    if pod.current_node < 0 or to_node < 0 or pod.current_node == to_node:
        return 0.0
    if pod.stateful or pod.has_pdb:
        return 0.0

    if target.suspended:
        return 0.0
    target_peak = peak_after(target, pod)
    if target_peak > 0.62:
        return 0.0
    from_node = state.nodes[pod.current_node]
    current_latency = from_node.latency_to_ms[to_node]
    if current_latency <= 0.0:
        return 0.0
    benefit = rate * current_latency

    cpu_cap_from = float(max(from_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap_from = float(max(from_node.mem_capacity, 1))
    source_cpu_after = float(max(from_node.cpu_allocated - pod.cpu_request, 0)) / cpu_cap_from
    source_mem_after = float(max(from_node.mem_allocated - pod.mem_request, 0)) / mem_cap_from

    source_peak_before = max(float(from_node.cpu_allocated) / cpu_cap_from, float(from_node.mem_allocated) / mem_cap_from)

    else:

    if target.power_idle_w < from_node.power_idle_w:

    if target.power_max_w < from_node.power_max_w:

        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1

            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]

                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]

    worst_prox = 0.5
